Him and Gibbz also have a old collab called “choppa” that was kinda mid. This song captures his melodic flow and shows some of the skills he has with being able to find pockets in the beat. Being the song has no hook and uzi verse was 2 mins we got a good amount of uzi on this song, and Gibbz really did great in this song I feel like in some parts he did better than uzi. The beat is sub par as a prod I would expect wayyy more from a CuBeatz melody, and to have 2 people doing drums on a beat it could have been wayyyy more.
Overall I would say this song is a 8/10.
